Wednesday's schedule features the Pacers hosting the 76ers at 7 p.m. ET, alongside two Conference USA football matchups. MTSU will face Kennesaw State at 7 p.m. ET, while New Mexico State will host Jacksonville State at 8 p.m. ET. There's also World Series Game 5 between the Rays and Brewers at 8 p.m. ET. The Pacers will be without guard Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) against Philadelphia.  Click here to claim the Novig promo code CBSSPORTS and get up to a $50 bonus :

 Pacers vs. 76ers prediction
 The Pacers experienced both extremes this week, hammering the Nets 136-109 on Sunday before losing 110-102 to the Bucks the following night. Tyrese Haliburton has scored at least 18 points in each of his four games since returning from an Achilles injury, but a hamstring issue has his availability in question. Ivica Zubac is out with an ankle injury, leaving Pascal Siakam with a demanding assignment against Philadelphia's frontcourt.
 The 76ers are 3-1 after Sunday's 106-93 loss to Detroit. Tyrese Maxey averages 28.8 points, and Joel Embiid posted 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists against Milwaukee before resting against the Pistons. LeBron James and Jaylen Brown give the visitors more ways to score. Embiid and VJ Edgecombe are expected back after missing Sunday's game, so Philly should have additional help available against Indiana. SportsLine forecasts a 121-113 Philadelphia victory.  Click here to claim the Novig promo code CBSSPORTS and get up to a $50 bonus : 
 Middle Tennessee vs. Kennesaw State prediction
 Middle Tennessee has won two straight by three points apiece, beating Delaware 33-30 and FIU 26-23 to improve to 4-3. Roman Gagliano has thrown for 1,404 yards, while running back Antonio Martin Jr. has 480. Cam'ron Lacy has 437 receiving yards. Derek Mason's team scored 59 points in those two games after Kansas shut it out on October 3.
 Kennesaw State has lost six straight, including a 34-6 defeat to Liberty. Three of the Owls' last four losses came by three points or fewer. Quarterback Rickie Collins has 1,426 passing yards, while Brayden Munroe and Javon Rogers each average roughly 50 receiving yards. On defense, Baron Hopson recorded 12 tackles against Liberty. The schools split their first two meetings, most recently a 24-16 Owls win last year. SportsLine forecasts a 29-28 Blue Raiders victory, although its simulations favor Kennesaw State staying within 2.5 points.  Click here to claim the Novig promo code CBSSPORTS and get up to a $50 bonus : 
 New Mexico State vs. Jacksonville State prediction
 New Mexico State comes home after beating Sam Houston 30-24, its second Conference USA win in three tries. James Jones rushed for a season-high 178 yards and a touchdown in the victory. He's amassed 777 yards on 119 carries, averaging 6.5 per attempt, and leads the conference with 111 rushing yards per game. Adam Damante threw two touchdowns against Sam Houston, both to A.J. Williams III. The Aggies have allowed only 109.1 rushing yards per contest, best in the conference.
 Jacksonville State comes in at 5-2 after four straight victories, most recently edging FIU 27-24 on October 13. Caden Creel averages 305.3 total yards per game, tops in Conference USA, and has thrown for 1,637 yards while rushing for another 500. Deondre Johnson leads the team's receivers with 431 yards. The Gamecocks haven't played in 15 days, giving them an extended break before Wednesday's contest.
